The [Move Registry](https://www.moveregistry.com) maps human-readable package names like `@suins/core` or `@deepbook/core` to on-chain package addresses. Backed by `mainnet.mvr.mystenlabs.com/v1`, or `testnet.mvr.mystenlabs.com/v1` when the call's network is testnet. Devnet has no registry endpoint.

Typical flows:

- *"What's the package for `@deepbook/core`?"* → `mvr_resolve(['@deepbook/core'])` → `0x4874e1...`. Hand the address to `get_package` for module/function details.
- *"What is package `0xf22f…`?"* → `mvr_reverse_resolve(['0xf22f…'])` → `@suins/core`.
- *"Find DeepBook-related packages"* → `mvr_search('deepbook', limit=20, is_linked=true)` → paginated list.
- *"Pin to a specific version"* → `mvr_resolve(['@suins/core/3'])` returns the v3 package address rather than the latest.

## mvr_get_package_info

- Title: MVR get package info
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Get the full Move Registry record for a single package name: metadata (description, homepage, icon), current version, on-chain package_address, the package_info object ID, and git source info (repo, branch, path) when registered.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | MVR name, e.g. '@suins/core'. Optionally version-pinned: '@suins/core/3'. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## mvr_resolve

- Title: MVR resolve
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Resolve one or more Move Registry (MVR) names to their on-chain package IDs. Names use the form '@org/app' (latest version) or '@org/app/N' for a pinned version. Use this to translate human-readable package names like '@suins/core' or '@deepbook/core' into addresses for use with other tools.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `names` | array of string (at least 1 items) | yes | One or more MVR names, e.g. ['@suins/core', '@deepbook/core/4']. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## mvr_resolve_struct

- Title: MVR resolve struct
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Resolve fully-qualified Move struct names (e.g. '@suins/core::config::Config') to their canonical type tag using the type's defining-package address. No generics — for parameterized types include them as '&lt;...>' and the registry will reject the request. Bulk-friendly.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `types` | array of string (at least 1 items) | yes | One or more struct paths, each '@org/app::module::Type'. Version-pinned names ('@org/app/N::module::Type') also accepted. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## mvr_reverse_resolve

- Title: MVR reverse resolve
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Reverse-lookup MVR names from one or more package addresses. Useful for enriching raw addresses (e.g. from get_package or transaction decoders) with their canonical '@org/app' name. Returns null for addresses with no registered name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package_ids` | array of string (at least 1 items) | yes | One or more package addresses (0x...). |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## mvr_search

- Title: MVR search
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Browse or search the Move Registry for packages. Searches name and description; returns one page (default 20 results) with a cursor for pagination. Pass `is_linked: true` to limit results to packages actually published on the current network.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | no | Substring to match against name or description. Omit to list all. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 50) | no | Page size (default 20, max 50). |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. |
| `is_linked` | boolean | no | If true, only return packages with a published package on mainnet or testnet. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |
